name: How much does landscape lighting installation typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does landscape lighting installation typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of landscape lighting installation varies significantly based on factors such as the size and complexity of your property, the number and type of fixtures chosen (e.g., LED, low-voltage), and the control system desired (e.g., smart home integration, timers). A custom design is essential for an accurate estimate. Generally, a professional system can range from a few thousand dollars for a basic setup to upwards of ten thousand for extensive, high-end installations. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on property size, fixture count/type, and control systems, typically ranging from a few thousand to over ten thousand dollars for professional installation.
